test_title: PYST 62: SSC GD Constable 2022 - Reasoning (Held On : 07 Feb 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Eight people, D, E, G, H, M, N, Y and Z are sitting in a straight line, facing north. Ans Y sits at one of the extreme ends of the line. Only two people sit between Y and Z. E sits third to the right of Z. Only four people sit between E and D. G sits at one of the positions to the right of E. N is not an immediate neighbour of Z. H sits second to the right of M. How many people sit to the left of M?
solution: The sitting arrangement as per the given information: 1. Y sits at one of the extreme ends of the line and only two people sit between Y and Z. ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/137a1f6941678cb5e097b35c15532bbb7fcebcddea78d8ca1cd5e9fd559ecb1d.png] **** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/730839e8ec8020f7d9f086327423626aae686bf64ab95b6c34575c17399c7527.png] ** 2. E sits third to the right of Z and only four people sit between E and D.
